USAGE:
    agentskills-cli [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    add <source>    Install one or more skills from a local folder, GitHub repo,
                    git URL, or NuGet/npm package                               
    list            List installed skills grouped by agent or package           
    remove          Remove installed skills                                     
    init            Scaffold a new SKILL.md                                     
    find            Search registered providers (skills.sh and any you register)
                    and install a result                                        
    update          Check tracked skills for upstream updates and (optionally)  
                    reinstall

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Install one or more skills from a local folder, GitHub repo, git URL, or 
NuGet/npm package

USAGE:
    agentskills-cli add <source> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <source>    Local path, GitHub shorthand (owner/repo), URL, or NuGet package
                id                                                              

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                  Prints help information                         
    -g, --global                Install to the user-wide directory instead of   
                                the project                                     
    -a, --agent <AGENTS>        Target specific agents (claude-code, codex,     
                                cursor, opencode, universal)                    
    -s, --skill <SKILLS>        Install specific skills by name. Use '*' for all
    -y, --yes                   Skip interactive prompts and accept defaults    
        --copy                  Copy files into each agent directory instead of 
                                symlinking                                      
        --symlink               Force symlink mode (default)                    
        --nuget-source <URL>    Override NuGet feed (otherwise the user's       
                                NuGet.config feeds are used)                    
        --npm-registry <URL>    Override the default npm registry (otherwise    
                                ~/.npmrc / project .npmrc + per-scope rules     
                                apply)                                          
        --path <PATH>           Restrict discovery to a subdirectory of the     
                                source. Overrides any subpath the source string 
                                carried (e.g. a GitHub /tree/.../path URL). Use 
                                when a package puts its skills somewhere        
                                non-conventional

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
List installed skills grouped by agent or package

USAGE:
    agentskills-cli list [TARGETS] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [TARGETS]    Only list skills matching these targets. Each argument is      
                 matched as a skill name first, then as a source (any shape     
                 `add` accepts). Omit to list everything                        

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help              Prints help information                             
    -g, --global            List globally installed skills                      
    -a, --agent <AGENTS>    Limit to specific agents                            
        --by <KEY>          Group the output. Valid values: package, path,      
                            agent, scope. Default is a flat table               
        --paths             Include a column with each skill's on-disk install  
                            path

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Remove installed skills

USAGE:
    agentskills-cli remove [TARGETS] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [TARGETS]    Skills to remove. Each argument is matched as a skill name     
                 first, then as a source (any shape `add` accepts: GitHub       
                 owner/repo, GitHub/GitLab URL, npm package id, NuGet package   
                 id, local path). Omit to be prompted                           

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help              Prints help information         
    -g, --global            Remove globally installed skills
    -a, --agent <AGENTS>    Limit removal to specific agents
    -y, --yes               Skip the confirmation prompt

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Search registered providers (skills.sh and any you register) and install a 
result

USAGE:
    agentskills-cli find [QUERY] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [QUERY]    Search query. When omitted, you'll be prompted interactively

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help               Prints help information                            
    -y, --yes                Skip the install confirmation when picking a result
    -g, --global             Install the chosen skill globally instead of into  
                             the project                                        
        --provider <NAME>    Restrict the search to specific providers (e.g.    
                             skills.sh). Repeatable. Omit to fan out across     
                             every enabled provider                             
        --list-providers     Print the registered search providers and exit

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Check tracked skills for upstream updates and (optionally) reinstall

USAGE:
    agentskills-cli update [SKILLS] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [SKILLS]    Only check these skill names. Omit to check everything tracked  
                in the lock                                                     

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information                          
    -g, --global     Limit to globally installed skills               
    -p, --project    Limit to project-installed skills                
    -y, --yes        Auto-confirm any updates instead of prompting    
        --check      Only report drifted skills; don't install updates
